sections.heading: Exercise
paragraphs: On 2026-08-21, 17 responders ran a simulated telemetry-queue compromise. SOC declared severity one in 12 minutes, isolated the workload in 19 minutes and identified the affected tenant in 27 minutes.

Observers verified bridge attendance, escalation to clinical operations, preserved event logs and a customer-communications draft. Four improvements were assigned; three closed by 2026-09-28 and the remaining item is a noncritical contact-list update due 2026-10-15.

sections.heading: Approval
paragraphs: The VP Security and clinical operations director signed the report on 2026-08-28. The 2026-09-23 check confirmed action evidence in the ticket archive.
